concepts.title: Governance and the Need for Rules
concepts.definition: Where many people live together, disagreements and disorder follow unless there are rules; governance is the process of making and applying such rules so that society keeps order and harmony.
concepts.key_idea: Rules at home, school and nation scale up into governance: someone must decide, and decisions must apply to all.

concepts.title: Democracy: Government by the People
concepts.definition: Democracy is a system where the people hold power: they choose their rulers through elections, rulers remain answerable to them, and every adult has a vote and a voice.
concepts.key_idea: In democracy, power flows upward from citizens, not downward from a ruler.

concepts.title: Values of Democracy
concepts.definition: Democracy rests on values: justice, liberty, equality and fraternity, respect for every culture's identity and dignity; without equality there is no justice, and without justice there is no peace, as Rigoberta Menchu Tum says.
concepts.key_idea: Elections alone are not democracy: the values of dignity and equality give elections their meaning.

concepts.title: Dharma Protects: An Ancient Insight
concepts.definition: The Mahabharata verse says the ruler protects dharma and dharma, in turn, protects those who protect it; power exists to uphold right order, and a ruler who upholds dharma is himself safeguarded.
concepts.key_idea: Ancient India already tied ruling to duty: government is legitimate only while it protects the right.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Why do people need a government at all?

solution_template.explain: Large numbers of people living together meet disagreements and disorder.
Rules made and applied fairly, that is governance, keep harmony so that everyone can live and work.

worked_examples.question_pattern: How is dharma protecting the ruler still true today?

solution_template.explain: The ruler who protects dharma is himself protected by dharma.
A government that acts justly earns citizens' trust, and that trust is its real shield.
